standard_prerequisites.name: Higher direct images on algebraic spaces are qc

core_obligations: Conditions (1)-(2) from lqc-colimits, (3) from check-lqc-on-etale-covering; suffices to verify (4) (proof lines 692-699).
Affine case: cartesian diagram, Z representable by Z = V x_Y X, f' qcqs (even affine) (proof lines 702-714).
R^i f_*F|_{V_etale} = R^i f'_{small,*}(g^*F|_{Z_etale}) by the comparison lemma; the right side is qc on V_etale by the Cohomology of Spaces lemma (proof lines 715-726).
proof_roadmap: Verify (4) in the affine case via base change to schemes.
difficulty_reason: Framework proof via the general-pushforward criterion: conditions (1)-(2) cited, (3) from the lqc descent lemma, and (4) verified in the affine case by a cartesian diagram with Z = V x_Y X, the representable-morphism cohomology comparison, and the Cohomology of Spaces higher-direct-image lemma giving qc on V_etale.
